channel.title: Ellis Services Group waterproofing and tiling guides
channel.description: Published Ellis Services Group guides on waterproofing, shower leak repairs, regrouting, curing and tiling quotes. Summaries only; follow the article links for full guidance.

item.title: Shower Repair Options: Grout, Silicone or Membrane?
item.description: Understand the boundaries between shower regrouting, flexible seal repairs, plumbing investigation and membrane work before choosing a repair in Adelaide.

item.title: Waterproofing Drying, Curing and Return to Use
item.description: Understand touch dry, recoat, ready to tile, full cure and return to traffic or water. Plan waterproofing and tiling around the selected materials and site conditions.

item.title: Comparing Waterproofing and Tiling Quotes
item.description: Compare waterproofing and tiling quotes by preparation, materials, finishes, access, variations and handover records. Understand the scope before choosing a repair.

item.title: Rainwater Leaks and Outdoor Tiles After Rain
item.description: Check rain-related roof, balcony and wall leaks, courtyard puddles and outdoor tiling readiness. Plan the repair scope with Ellis in Adelaide.

item.title: Choosing Tiles for Bathrooms, Kitchens and Pool Surrounds
item.description: Compare porcelain, ceramic, stone and mosaic tiles by wet-floor grip, wall cleaning, kitchen splashes and care. Plan materials and installation with Ellis.

item.title: Choosing Waterproofing Materials for Wet Areas, Balconies and Roofs
item.description: Compare waterproofing membranes, primers, joint details and moisture barriers. We plan suitable systems for bathrooms, balconies, roofs and pools.
